get.description: Retrieve all assets for a given asset type with in an organization. To get the assertTypeId use [List Asset Types](https://developers.everbridge.net/home/reference/ebs-list-asset-types) endpoint.

parameters.description: Available on manager portal (Settings --> Organization --> Contacts/Assets --> Assert Types)
parameters.name: assetTypeId

parameters.description: Supports name and externalId. It is case-insensitive and uses the 'contains' criteria. For example 'os' will return Boston.
parameters.name: searchValue

parameters.description: The page number of assets to return.
parameters.name: pageNumber

parameters.description: The page size of assets to return.
parameters.name: pageSize
